name: word-rotate
title: Word Rotate
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { WordRotate } from '@/components/ui/word-rotate'
</script>

<template>
  <WordRotate class="text-4xl font-bold" :words="['Word', 'Rotate']" />
</template>

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds each word stays on screen.

props.name: motionProps
props.description: Motion props applied to each word (`initial`, `animate`, `exit`, `transition`). With reduced motion and no custom props, words cross-fade without moving.
